name: mmc-plugins
description: Microbiome metadata harmonization plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: microbiome-harmonization
plugins.description: Fetch and harmonize microbiome study metadata from ENA (PRJEB/ERP) and CNCB-GSA (PRJCA/CRA). Extract abstracts, disease annotations, and sample-level attributes. Classify samples into disease/control cohorts.
